factsSinceLastLlm.text: Define CultivateStartupError with error codes: Verified CultivateStartupError implementation. All acceptance criteria met: error codes defined (REDIS_UNAVAILABLE, SQLITE_INIT_FAILED, ML_MODEL_LOAD_FAILED, ANTHROPIC_UNAVAILABLE, plus additional codes), diagnostics object includes dependency/connectionInfo(sanitized)/retryAttempts, instanceof check works correctly. Static factory methods provided for all error codes. Implementation includes toJSON() for structured logging. Code follows TypeScript conventions with proper readonly properties and JSDoc comments.

Define SignalFilteredError and SignalProcessingError: Verified SignalFilteredError and SignalProcessingError implementations in packages/cultivate/src/errors.ts. All acceptance criteria met: filter_tier is 0|1|2 union type, rule_name defaults to empty string (populated for tier 1), pipeline_step and signal_id present for dead-letter tracking. No changes required.
